ranked_evidence.title: Agriculture Minister Gita Chaudhary Announces Model Program for 10 Municipalities - Ratopati
ranked_evidence.snippet: # Agriculture Minister Gita Chaudhary Announces Model Program for 10 Municipalities. Minister for Agriculture, Forest and Environment Gita Chaudhary has stated that at least 10 municipalities will be selected as model programs and implemented, prioritizing agricultural research, technology transfer, and organic farming, to directly deliver services to the farmers' fields. Addressing a courtesy meeting with the Chief Minister of Madhesh Province, Krishna Prasad Yadav, and a high-level meeting regarding federal-provincial coordination, Minister Chaudhary said that at least 10 municipalities should be selected. She stated that there is a plan to implement a model agricultural program in those municipalities. She informed that an integrated program will be operated in at least 10 municipalities to deliver research results to the farmers' fields, increase agricultural production, and provide direct information about modern technology to the farmers. She emphasized the need to move forward through effective coordination between the federal, provincial, and local levels, proper mobilization of resources, and joint planning for the sustainable development of the agriculture, forest, and environment sectors.

ranked_evidence.snippet: # Why So Many Young Women Are Dealing With Fatigue That Sleep Can’t Fix. Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. As opposed to burnout, which has recently dominated the exhaustion conversation among women, prolonged fatigue is an enduring, low-grade exhaustion that doesn't resolve with rest and isn't always directly linked to workload. "We are seeing a significant increase in young women presenting with persistent fatigue," says Dr. Tony Banerjee, global chief medical officer at NADclinic. "What's striking is that many of these women are high-functioning, career-driven individuals who appear 'well' externally, but are struggling with chronic low energy, brain fog, poor sleep quality, and reduced resilience.". "It is a persistent reduction in physical, mental, or emotional energy that is disproportionate to activity levels and not fully relieved by rest," explains Dr. Ahmed El Muntasar, who says he's also seeing a significant increase in female patients presenting with prolonged exhaustion.

ranked_evidence.title: BEST To Invest Rs 6,500 Crore In 5,000 Self-Owned Electric Buses, Plans 10,000-Bus Fleet To Reduce Dependence On Wet-Lease Operations - Swarajya
ranked_evidence.snippet: # BEST To Invest Rs 6,500 Crore In 5,000 Self-Owned Electric Buses, Plans 10,000-Bus Fleet To Reduce Dependence On Wet-Lease Operations. BEST electric buses (BEST Bus Transport). The Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) undertaking has unveiled a long-term strategy to rebuild its own bus fleet, announcing plans to acquire 5,000 self-owned electric buses as part of a wider target of operating 10,000 buses across Mumbai over the next two to three years. The move marks a significant shift away from the wet-lease model that has dominated BEST's operations in recent years. Speaking after a BEST committee meeting, General Manager Sonia Sethi said the undertaking currently relies more on wet-lease buses than vehicles owned by the transport utility. While BEST currently operates around 2,800 buses and is set to induct 1,500 wet-lease electric buses under the Centre's PM e-Bus Scheme, officials said future fleet expansion will increasingly focus on company-owned vehicles beyond the scheme's support period ending in 2027.

ranked_evidence.title: BEST gets state nod to buy 5,000 self-owned AC e-buses | Mumbai news - Hindustan Times
ranked_evidence.snippet: # BEST gets state nod to buy 5,000 self-owned AC e-buses. Mumbai: After a decade, the Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) undertaking has received the state government’s approval to procure 5,000 self-owned AC electric buses at an estimated cost of ₹6,500 crore, marking a major shift away from its dependence on the wet-lease model. “We have received the minutes of the meeting from the deputy chief minister’s office approving the procurement of 5,000 AC e-buses for our owned fleet. The buses will be self-owned, with drivers, as in the past, and will be procured at an estimated cost of ₹6,500 crore,” said Sonia Sethi, general manager, BEST. The procurement, expected to be completed over the next three to four years, is part of BEST’s long-term plan to build a fleet of 10,000 buses. Officials said BEST will now work on a financial model for the procurement, which is expected to be placed before the BEST Committee within the next month.
